summary.text: Antonio Wilson is a Democrat from Madison Parish who describes himself as a businessman, builder, father and community leader. He holds an MBA and has pursued doctoral-level graduate study, according to his Ballotpedia biography. He is running on economic development, infrastructure and investment in people.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a product of Madison Parish who completed his schooling in the Madison Parish school system.
According to his Ballotpedia biography, pursued undergraduate studies, earned an MBA and continued graduate education through the doctoral level.
Describes himself as a business owner and general contractor.
